description: This file contains shell script code for testing git p4 label operations, including setting up depot files, applying labels, cloning repositories, and verifying label application via tests.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up git repository state after tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after test completion.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: p4 label
methods.description: Creates or gets labels in Perforce.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones Perforce depot into Git, with label detection.

methods.name: git tag
methods.description: Lists tags in the git repository.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Checks out specific tags or branches.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in output, used to confirm correct operations.
